question: Should dashboard widget distribution be a bundled Workspaces gallery that writes `widgetsRegistry`, a ClawHub-backed package/discovery flow, or deferred until a widget SDK/package contract is accepted?
rationale: Current main has plugin-tab and plugin distribution seams but no dashboard widget substrate, and VISION.md puts discovery/provenance in ClawHub while also prioritizing web frontend ergonomics.

options.title: Defer until substrate and SDK settle
options.body: Keep this issue open as the specific gallery item, but do not queue implementation until the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and widget SDK/distribution boundary have maintainer approval.

options.title: Bundle a dashboard gallery
options.body: Approve a Workspaces UI gallery that writes to `widgetsRegistry` through the approval gate, accepting that OpenClaw owns widget discovery UX and security review in this plugin.

options.title: Route distribution through ClawHub
options.body: Require widgets to be published as ClawHub/package artifacts first and make the dashboard consume vetted metadata rather than raw arbitrary install URLs.

recommendation.title: Defer until substrate and SDK settle
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the specific gallery item, but do not queue implementation until the Wave 1 dashboard PRs and widget SDK/distribution boundary have maintainer approval.

likelyOwner.reason: The current plugin-tab seam and registry descriptor implementation on main blame to Vincent Koc's merged PR 101043 carry commit.
